# Shared Agent Sync Rules
1. Before starting any task, read AI_SHARED_MEMORY.md (at docs/AI_SHARED_MEMORY.md in the web repo, or AI_SHARED_MEMORY.md in healthwing_mobile).
2. Respect strict folder ownership: Copilot Fusion edits only the PHP web repo; Antigravity edits only healthwing_mobile.
3. Keep all 3-role RBAC rules (owner, vet_staff, head_vet), RA 10173 / RA 9268 compliance, zero emojis, and "Loading..." labels intact.
4. After completing a task, append a 2-3 line entry to the Handoff Log in AI_SHARED_MEMORY.md noting changed files, contract updates, and verification results.
